full_name: Sandra Susan Smith | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 Social Sciences Carol K. Pforzheimer Professor Harvard Kennedy School
bio: Sandra Susan Smith is the Carol K. Pforzheimer Professor at Harvard Radcliffe Institute and the Daniel and Florence Guggenheim Professor of Criminal Justice and faculty director of the Program in Criminal Justice Policy and Management at Harvard Kennedy School.
